title: Capture chat and agent feature doc screenshots
description:
Problem: `features/chat-and-agent` now includes screenshot placeholders and flow visuals but lacks captured assets.

Desired outcome: capture and embed images for FEAT-CHAT placeholders to improve operator and contributor onboarding.

Scope:
- In scope: FEAT-CHAT-01..05 screenshot capture, privacy review, image storage under `Data/Pages/assets`, and markdown insertion.
- Out of scope: production TLS or health diagnostics captures.

Acceptance criteria:
- All FEAT-CHAT placeholders are fulfilled with image assets and embeds.
- Screenshots avoid private usernames, tokens, and sensitive payload content.
- Trace and proposal examples are readable and match current UI behavior.

Validation:
- Open `features/chat-and-agent` in `/pages` and verify all images render correctly with consistent sequence.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created to track FEAT-CHAT screenshot capture and insertion.
